title: Breakout-Pullback Strategy
description: Trend continuation strategy that enters after a breakout and a pullback retest.
entry: Close > R1 and Close > VWAP and Volume > Vol_Avg20

title: Moving Average Crossover + RSI Filter
description: Fast/slow EMA crossover filtered by RSI to avoid extreme momentum entries.
entry: EMA_9 > EMA_21 and RSI_14 > 50 and Close > EMA_9

title: Supertrend + Volume Confirmation Strategy
description: Trend signal approximated by EMA + volume spike confirmation (supertrend not available in indicators).
entry: Close > EMA_21 and Volume >= Vol_Avg20 * 1.5 and Close > SMA_20

title: RSI Divergence Reversal Strategy
description: Practical executable approximation: looks for momentum divergence proxy and confirmation candle.
entry: RSI_14 > 30 and Close > SMA_20 and Volume > Vol_Avg20

title: Bollinger Band Squeeze + MACD Explosion
description: Enter breakouts after a Bollinger Band squeeze when MACD confirms momentum.
rule: BB_width < BB_width.rolling(20).mean() and (MACD_hist > 0 or MACD > MACD_signal)
entry: Close > BB_upper and (MACD > MACD_signal or MACD_hist > 0)

title: Order Flow Imbalance Strategy
description: Executable approximation using delta ratio and structure flags (delta must be provided by datafeed).
entry: delta_ratio >= delta_threshold and ((Close - Open) * sign(delta_ratio) > 0)

title: VWAP Reversion Strategy
description: Mean-reversion to intraday VWAP when price deviates outside defined bands.
entry: Close < VWAP - VWAP_deviation_threshold * VWAP and (Close - Open) > 0

title: Multi-Timeframe Trend Alignment Strategy
description: Require trend agreement across HTF/ITF/LTF then enter on lower timeframe trigger (implemented via precomputed flags).
entry: LTF_trigger == 1 and ITF_setup_aligned == 1 and HTF_trend == direction

title: Ichimoku Cloud Momentum Trade
description: Use Ichimoku cloud + Tenkan/Kijun + Chikou confirmation to trade momentum (requires Ichimoku fields).
rule: Close > SenkouA and Tenkan > Kijun and Chikou_span > Close
entry: Tenkan_cross_up_Kijun == 1 and Close > SenkouA

title: Fibonacci Scalping Strategy
description: Scalp pullbacks into Fibonacci retracement zones after an impulsive move.
entry: in_fib_golden_pocket == 1 and reversal_candle == 1

title: ATR Volatility Breakout Strategy
description: Enter breakouts when ATR expands beyond a recent average (volatility expansion).
rule: ATR_14 >= (ATR_14.rolling(20).mean()) * 1.5 and (Close > range_high or Close < range_low)
entry: Close > range_high and ATR_14 >= (ATR_14.rolling(20).mean()) * 1.5
exit: Close <= range_high and Close >= range_low or stop_loss_hit == 1

title: EMA Stack Momentum Ride
description: Ride a momentum trend when multiple EMAs are aligned and price pulls back into the stack.
rule: EMA_9 > EMA_21 and EMA_21 > EMA_50 and (EMA_9 - EMA_50) > 0
entry: abs(Close - EMA_21) <= EMA_21 * 0.005 and (Close - Open) > 0

title: Market Structure Shift + Fair Value Gap (SMC)
description: Trade after a break of structure and retrace into a Fair Value Gap / order block with confirmation (FVG/OB flags required).
entry: Close >= fvg_low and Close <= fvg_high and reversal_candle == 1 and Volume > Vol_Avg20

title: Gold/USD Inverse Correlation + DXY Momentum Model
description: Use DXY momentum as a leading signal for the inverse move in Gold; confirm with Gold structure.
entry: DXY_breakout == 1 and gold_reversal_at_support == 1 and Volume > Vol_Avg20

title: Multi-Timeframe Trend Synchronization with ATR Targets
description: Align HTF/ITF/LTF trends and size stops/targets by ATR on the chosen timeframe.
entry: LTF_trigger == 1 and ATR_14 > 0 and ITF_setup_aligned == 1

title: Quantitative Volatility Breakout (ATR + Range Expansion Model)
description: Systematic breakout when ATR expands and price breaks the consolidation range.
entry: Close > range_high and ATR_14 >= (ATR_14.rolling(20).mean()) * 1.5 and Volume > Vol_Avg20

title: Relative Strength + Macro Filter (Gold vs. Silver Spread)
description: Use Gold/Silver ratio plus macro-condition filter to bias trades in gold or silver (macro flags required).
entry: ratio_moves_towards_mean == 1 and (Close - Open) * sign(mean_diff) > 0

title: Liquidity Void Scalping (FVG + Order Block Confluence)
description: Scalp retracements into FVG + Order Block confluence zones on low timeframes (requires FVG/OB flags).
entry: Close >= fvg_low and Close <= fvg_high and reversal_candle == 1 and Volume > Vol_Avg20

title: Delta Volume Exhaustion Strategy
description: Use delta-volume exhaustion near structure to time reversals or quick continuations (requires delta data).
entry: delta_turns_positive_after_exhaustion == 1 and reversal_candle == 1

title: Mean Reversion via Statistical Bands (Z-Score / Kalman Filter)
description: Quantitative mean-reversion: enter when Z-score crosses thresholds against a Kalman/moving estimate.
entry: (z_score <= -z_lower_threshold and RSI_14 > 30) or (z_score >= z_upper_threshold and RSI_14 < 70)
